verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents HubSpot's REST APIs, an OpenAPI-spec-per-endpoint, a CLI (@hubspot/cli), and MCP servers, but nowhere mentions official client SDKs/libraries (e.g., Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby SDKs) that an AI-native developer would build against. Missing for 10: any documentation of official SDK packages, language coverage, or SDK release/versioning cadence.
